name: missing_info_freetext
description: gt passage와 retrieved passage를 비교해 retrieved 쪽에 빠진 정보를 서술

questions.prompt: Does the retrieved passage miss information from the reference that is needed to answer the question?

instructions.title: What does the retrieved passage miss?
instructions.summary: Compare a retrieved passage against the reference passage and describe what information needed for the question is missing.
instructions.background: We know which passage contains the answer (the reference). We want to characterize what retrieved passages lack, to improve the retriever.
definitions: A passage known to contain the answer.
The retrieved passage cannot answer the question at all.
howto: Read the question and the reference passage.
Choose a category and describe the gap in one or two sentences.
instructions.tip: Focus on information relevant to the question, not every difference between the texts.
